notes:
Preview / Release Candidate. Stable remains v0.1.3 and is still the default installation.

This release preserves the sealed four-file Runtime ZIP. Preview requires Windows, PowerShell 7.4+, local fixed NTFS and an available D drive. It introduces guarded single-file Prepare / Apply / trusted Check / Finalize, Cancel, Close and conditional Completed historical Restore. Check is not an OS sandbox; semantic decisions remain the Agent's responsibility.

Read README and references/protocol.md before use. Keep your Stable installation; test Preview in a separate explicit location. Repository-hosted historical fallback is pinned to this tag.
